description: Search for verified service professionals in Argentina by service type, city, neighborhood, verification status, minimum rating, and minimum review count. Returns a paginated list of professionals with display name, headline, ratings, verifications, and a `profile_url` that is the only sanctioned contact channel (no phone/email/whatsapp is ever returned). Use this for discovery; use `muovi_get_professional` for the full detail payload.

city.description: City slug (e.g. "caba"). Matches `City.slug` in the catalog.

has_matricula.description: When true, only return pros with a verified professional matrícula on file (electricians, gas fitters, etc.).

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page (default 20, max 50).

neighborhood.description: Neighborhood slug (e.g. "palermo"). Matches `Neighborhood.slug` in the catalog.

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the result set for pagination.

service.description: Service slug (e.g. "electricidad"). Matches `Service.slug` in the catalog.

verified_identity.description: When true, only return pros whose identity has been verified by Muovi.

name: muovi_search_professionals
title: Search professionals
